captions.gbp:
Wondering what a bone density (DEXA) scan is like? It takes about 10 minutes and you stay fully clothed. You lie back on a padded table while an open scanner arm passes over your hip and spine. There are no needles and no tunnel. To prepare, skip calcium supplements for 24 hours before, wear clothes without metal zippers, buttons or belts, and tell us if you recently had a barium study or contrast scan, or might be pregnant. Afterward you can get right back to your day, and results go to your doctor within 72 hours. Screening is recommended for women 65 and older and for younger women after menopause with risk factors; for men, ask your doctor. Self-pay bone density scans are $75 with no referral needed.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.
